physicalNotes: Radius 0.20430047 Jupiter radii from Toledo-Padrón et al. 2020 (2020A&A...641A..92T), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...641A..92T/abstract): 14,605.8 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.02611472 Jupiter masses (Toledo-Padrón et al. 2020, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2020A&A...641A..92T), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020A&A...641A..92T/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM.
